name: BAM-15
effects: increased energy expenditure without hyperthermia (mouse data)

mechanismOfAction.summary: Selective mitochondrial uncoupler; transports protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane without depolarizing the plasma membrane.
mechanismOfAction.description: Lipophilic weak acid protonophore; dissipates the inner mitochondrial membrane proton-motive force, increasing energy expenditure. Key distinction from DNP: does not depolarize the plasma membrane at therapeutic concentrations in mice, and does not raise body temperature. Mouse data: oral bioavailability ~67%, t½ ~1.7 h (oral gavage) or ~3 h (food admixture) in C57BL/6J mice. No human PK. Community dosing speculation is based on allometric scaling from mouse and is highly speculative.
